reasoning_content: Let me get the browser console errors by running JavaScript in the page context:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check if there are any errors in server log
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -50 /tmp/server.log")
print("Server log:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
